# Geo map (`geo-map`)

Drawn map of places, areas and routes from coordinates; tile background optional.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createGeoMap` (types in `dist/web/media/geoMap.d.ts`): `.mh-geo-map`: places, areas and routes drawn from coordinates on a plain themed background. Web Mercator,fitted to the contents (or, with `fit: 'focus'`, to the places and accent shapes, muted shapes shown ascontext). Nothing is loaded unless `tiles` is set: then `--tiles` adds a `__tiles` layer of `<imgclass="__tile">` under the drawing (toned by `--mh-geo-map-tile-filter`), drops the grid and shows`__attribution`. Parts: `__svg` with `__grid`, `__shape` (`--accent | --muted`, `--line`) and `__accuracy`;HTML `__name`, `__point` (`--neutral`, `--home` with a house icon), `__label` (`--start` near the right edge;places drawn on top of each other share one label) and `__scale` with `__scale-text`. `role="img"` with asummary of the contents.

```ts
export function createGeoMap(options: GeoMapOptions): GeoMapHandle;

export interface GeoMapOptions extends GeoMapData {
  /** Accessible name ("Map"); a summary of the contents is added. */
  label: string;
}

export interface GeoMapHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Redraws with new options. */
  update(options: GeoMapOptions): void;
  /** Stops watching the element's size (only acted on with tiles). */
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface GeoMapData {
  points: readonly GeoMapPoint[];
  shapes: readonly GeoMapShape[];
  fit?: GeoMapFit;
  /** Width / height (default 16 / 10). */
  aspect?: number;
  /** Raster tiles under the drawing; off by default (then nothing is loaded). */
  tiles?: GeoMapTiles | null;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createGeoMap, type GeoMapPoint, type GeoMapShape } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const home: GeoMapShape = { name: 'Home', tone: 'muted', circle: { lat: 50.9965, lon: 6.9935, radius: 150 } };
const park: GeoMapShape = {
  name: 'Willow Green',
  tone: 'accent',
  rings: [
    [
      [7.0, 51.0],
      [7.008, 51.0005],
      [7.006, 51.0052],
      [7.0, 51.0],
    ],
  ],
};
const sam: GeoMapPoint = { lat: 51.0021, lon: 7.004, label: 'Sam', accuracy: 40 };

const options = {
  label: 'Where Sam is',
  shapes: [home, park],
  // Your tile server's XYZ template and the credit it asks for; leave `tiles` out to load nothing.
  tiles: { url: 'https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', attribution: '© Example Maps', maxZoom: 19 },
};
const map = createGeoMap({ ...options, points: [sam] });

document.body.append(map.el);

// A new position arrives: redraw with it.
setTimeout(() => map.update({ ...options, points: [{ ...sam, lat: 50.9972, lon: 6.9941, accuracy: 15 }] }), 3000);
```

## React API

`GeoMap` (types in `dist/react/media.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createGeoMap`: drawn from coordinates; nothing is loaded unless `tiles` is set. With tiles, the rendered width is measured (360 px until then) to choose the tile zoom.

```ts
export function GeoMap({ label, points, shapes, fit, aspect, tiles, className }: GeoMapProps);

export interface GeoMapProps {
  /** Accessible name ("Map"); a summary of the contents is added. */
  label: string;
  points: readonly GeoMapPoint[];
  shapes: readonly GeoMapShape[];
  fit?: GeoMapFit;
  /** Width / height (default 16 / 10). */
  aspect?: number;
  /** Raster tiles under the drawing; off by default (then nothing is loaded). */
  tiles?: GeoMapTiles | null;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { GeoMap } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { GeoMapPoint, GeoMapShape, GeoMapTiles } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const HOME: GeoMapShape = { name: 'Home', tone: 'muted', circle: { lat: 50.9965, lon: 6.9935, radius: 150 } };
const PARK: GeoMapShape = {
  name: 'Willow Green',
  tone: 'accent',
  rings: [
    [
      [7.0, 51.0],
      [7.008, 51.0005],
      [7.006, 51.0052],
      [7.0, 51.0],
    ],
  ],
};
// Your tile server's XYZ template and the credit it asks for; leave `tiles` out to load nothing.
const TILES: GeoMapTiles = { url: 'https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', attribution: '© Example Maps', maxZoom: 19 };

export function GeoMapExample() {
  const [sam, setSam] = useState<GeoMapPoint>({ lat: 51.0021, lon: 7.004, label: 'Sam', accuracy: 40 });
  useEffect(() => {
    // A new position arrives.
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setSam((p) => ({ ...p, lat: 50.9972, lon: 6.9941, accuracy: 15 })), 3000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  return <GeoMap label="Where Sam is" points={[sam]} shapes={[HOME, PARK]} tiles={TILES} />;
}
```
